distribution.summary: Anhui; Beijing; Guizhou; Hebei; Jiangsu; Shandong; Sichuan; Taiwan; Zhejiang
distribution.narrative: Earlier 殷蕙芬等 (1984)/黄复生等 (2015) evidence supports Beijing, Shandong, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Anhui, Sichuan, and Guizhou; Beaver & Liu (2010) supports Taiwan. Yang (2020) additionally lists Hebei. The reviewed synthesis now includes Hebei without extrapolating beyond the source-supported provinces.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) both report Morus alba (桑). Beaver & Liu (2010) states that the species usually attacks Morus alba and cautions that other reported broad-leaved host records may include errors. Morus alba remains the only host promoted into the current synthesis.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus exiguus Blandford, 1894.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus pilosus
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 238.

taxonomic_history.name: Cryphalus exiguus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Cryphalus exiguus Blandford, 1894, VSN_1691. 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) preserve the source misspelling Cryphalus exignus; Beaver & Liu (2010) uses Cryphalus exiguus. The misspelling is retained only at source level.
